info.name: EduSphere API
info.description: Session-cookie auth. Log in first (Auth folder); the collection script adds the X-XSRF-TOKEN header automatically. Swagger UI: {{baseUrl}}/swagger-ui.html

exec: // Every write needs the CSRF header. Make sure the cookie exists, then echo it in X-XSRF-TOKEN.
const put = () => { const t = pm.cookies.get('XSRF-TOKEN'); if (t) pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'X-XSRF-TOKEN', value: t }); };

request.description: Sets the XSRF-TOKEN cookie. The collection pre-request script also does this automatically.
